Definition: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
BiblicalUsage: 1) grasp, take hold, seize, take possession; 1a) (Qal) to grasp, take hold of; 1b) (Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled; 1c) (Piel) to enclose, overlay; 1d) (Hophal) fastened
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
